title: UI风格#105 - Brutalist Architecture (粗野建筑)
description: 创建第105种UI风格：粗野建筑风格 - 混凝土雕塑、现代主义、纪念碑感。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDA.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Architecture style When color palette Then features raw concrete, exposed steel, tinted glass, shadow gray
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#A9A9A9 (混凝土), #2F4F4F (钢青), #87CEEB (玻璃蓝), #696969 (阴影灰), #1C1C1C (深影)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Architecture style When typography Then uses monumental fonts: Oswald, Roboto Mono, or Space Mono
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Oswald (粗体), Roboto Mono (正文), Space Mono (数据)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Architecture style When layout Then concrete forms, pilotis, brise-soliel, ribbon windows
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：混凝土形体、底层架空、遮阳板、带形窗

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Architecture style When UI elements Then raw concrete texture, steel connections, geometric shadows
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：混凝土质感、钢结构连接、几何阴影、纪念碑式

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Architecture UI When functional Then includes monumental chat, architect agents, structure stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：纪念碑聊天、建筑代理、结构统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Architecture UI When copy Then uses architectural: 'Form', 'Mass', 'Void', 'Structure'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'FORM. MASS. VOID.'、按钮'SEND'→'CONSTRUCT'、'SUBMIT'→'ESTABLISH'
